answer: Attention continuity proof requires each identity to maintain a lantern-bright, sable-threaded log of continuous task focus spanning a defined rolling horizon. The enforcement rule is concrete: any sixty-second gap severs that thread and resets the identity's accumulated credit to zero. An attacker then pays the per-identity cost of one full undivided attention stream in compute and time, so spawning N sybils multiplies their drain until net yield turns negative.
